title: Keys: primary, foreign, business and surrogate
objectives: Tell business, surrogate, primary and foreign keys apart
Build a dimension with a unique surrogate key and its business key
Check that every fact row finds its dimension row

exercises.prompt: Make dim_customer (customer_key, customer_code once each, name) and fact_sales (sale_id, customer_key, amount), where every sale finds its customer.
hints: C-001 is in src_customers twice. How many customer_key values does the starter give it?
Number the rows of (SELECT DISTINCT customer_code, name FROM src_customers) so each customer gets one key.
fact_sales needs customer_key, not customer_code: join src_sales to dim_customer on customer_code.
